intro: Visual work, music, and objects made with curiosity, feeling, and a little bit of the unexpected.
bio: Born in the Pacific Northwest and raised in the Midwest, Hollie Hix is a professional mixed-media artist from Southern Illinois that challenges the status quo. Her work explores creativity as a force for personal freedom, drawing inspiration from a lifetime spent pursuing diverse artistic disciplines. While most people dedicate their lives to one thing, she has dipped her toes into many avenues to gain inspiration for not only her creative endeavors on paper, but also her career as a singer-songwriter. With six studio albums out, Hix has won multiple awards for her songs Into the Light, My Only One, On My Own. While finding herself playing stages big and small, her passion also lies in studio art where her creativity knows no bounds. Hix began her formal artistic training in 2012 at the Academy of Art University in San Francisco to study oil painting and figure drawing at 15 years old. After taking some time off school to tour, she continued her passion for learning at Southwestern Illinois College where she received her Associate of Fine Arts degree in 2023, that fall she decided to start her path to her Bachelor of Fine Arts Degree at Southern Illinois University Edwardsville where she graduated in 2026. Passionate about both artmaking and education, Hix aims to create a studio environment where artists can develop their skills, confidence, and creative voices. Through her work, she encourages viewers to embrace imagination, challenge the norm, and recognize creativity as a pathway to connection and freedom.
statement: My current works deal with what it means to be a saint in everyday life. You can find my work
